issue.title: Mobile and fleet gate actions block the gateway request on full gate execution
issue.description:
Found by the sase-zr landing audit (sase-zr note #2, gap 8) and detailed in phase mobile-submission of the rejected completion plan (plan:202609/sase_zr_completion.md). Deliberately deferred out of the narrowed sase-zr close-out epic by owner decision on 2026-09-16.

The sase-zr contract required every surface to use the shared durable gate submission, with a prompt accepted result exposed through an additive, versioned wire field in the sase-core gateway contract (contracts/api_v1/mobile_api_v1.json, contract.rs). Older clients must keep the synchronous response_json contract.

task_type_fields.impact: Mobile and fleet gate presses hang for the full execution (tens of seconds or more for commit-bearing approvals); a gateway timeout loses the result even though execution continues, and the decision-lifecycle failed outcome is not exposed through mobile projections.
task_type_fields.repro: Answer a commit-bearing plan-approval gate through the mobile gateway (or the fleet-attention route in sase-core sase_gateway routes.rs, execute_fleet_attention): execute_mobile_gate_action runs execute_gate_selection synchronously, so the HTTP request blocks until option commands, archive publication and successor launch all finish.
